data: In the 18th and 19th centuries, the work of Faraday, Oersted and others showed that the forces of electricity and magnetism can be explained by postulating the existence of a ‘field’ that pervades through space. This field concept allows us to formulate a combined theory of electricity and magnetism called electromagnetism. We will discuss the laws of Coulomb and Gauss in electrostatics and Biot-Savart’s law of magnetism. The properties of these fields in a medium allow us to understand polarization and magnetization of materials. On the theoretical side, these concepts lay the foundation for the first major ‘unification’ of forces in the history of physics – modern theory of electromagnetism.
